label: Scene Template: Screencast Showcase
description: WHOLE-SCENE template for scenes whose star is a REAL screen recording. Lit atmosphere background, small-caps kicker, the footage presented in a polished macos-browser frame (crop:'auto' removes the recording's own window chrome via ingest analysis), and timed caption chips in a reserved bottom band. Use for ANY screencast/screen-recording scene -- raw footage on a bare canvas is a composition failure. Instantiation adds the screencast-frame component automatically; give this template the footage URL as 'source'. Set presentation:'float' for the cinematic dark-world treatment (default in dark-forward films); pass callouts to spotlight UI regions in sync with narration.

captions.label: Array of {at, text}: caption chips timed in scene seconds

presentation.label: browser (default, light scenes) | float (3D world: tilted plane, orbit drift, reflection). Float defaults DARK (WebGL ribbon backdrop); float + theme:'light' = white-room float (lit light world, no backdrop).

callouts.label: Array of {at, dur?, x, y, w, h}: glow callouts -- a region of the footage (% of frame) lifts out zoomed in a gradient shell at `at` seconds. Derive from beats where narration highlights part of the UI.

backdrop_image.label: On-brand backdrop image URL (e.g. a brand-kit background asset). Replaces the grid/WebGL world: slow Ken Burns drift + legibility scrim, light or dark theme.
